condition: arrow.get(s, "X") on a long, non-matching string of digits takes quadratic time because _TIMESTAMP_RE backtracks, which allows a ReDoS from untrusted input.
workaround: Limit the input length or validate it with a non-ambiguous regex such as ^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$ before calling arrow.get with "X", or convert the value with float() and call arrow.get(float_value).
